title: Derivatives state and carry
purpose: Study funding, basis, open interest, liquidations, term structure, and delta-neutral carry as distinct claims.

readyWork.summary: Audit point-in-time funding, basis, spot, perpetual, rule identity, membership, and both execution legs for historical delta-neutral carry.
deliverables: Source matrix for funding, mark, index, spot, perpetual, rule identity, membership, and both execution legs
Causal clock and gap audit with official-byte provenance
DATA_FEASIBILITY evidence that either unlocks reconstruction or preserves DATA_BLOCKED
acceptanceCriteria: Every required carry leg has point-in-time availability semantics
Missing synchronized basis or executable-leg data produces DATA_BLOCKED
No funding-only directional proxy is substituted for carry

readyWork.summary: Evaluate synchronized basis convergence and executable hedged carry.
acceptanceCriteria: Evaluate synchronized basis convergence and executable hedged carry.
No epistemic stage is promoted without linked evidence

readyWork.summary: Specify causal funding and basis reconstruction, both legs, and conservative cost accounting.
externalBlockers: Historical spot top-of-book or book snapshots are absent from official monthly archives.
Historical exchange-rule, fee-schedule, and borrow-availability vintages are absent.
deliverables: Exact funding, mark/index, spot, perpetual, fee, and timing contract
Coverage and fail-closed rules for every required leg
acceptanceCriteria: Funding alone is never treated as carry
Both legs and basis convergence are causally reconstructable
Any missing execution or rule identity keeps the candidate DATA_BLOCKED

readyWork.summary: Run a deterministic delta-neutral carry replay before considering any model search.
deliverables: Immutable replay rows with both legs, funding, fees, and basis convergence
acceptanceCriteria: No directional model or parameter family is introduced
Missing prices, funding, or execution state fail closed
Result remains EXPLORATORY until a separate untouched confirmation is frozen
